name: Tamarind drink
description: Tamarind pulp strained, sweetened and iced — a Ramadan table fixture.

tcm.note: Follows tamarind, which is cool and generates fluids.

ayurveda.note: Amlika is amla-rasa and ushna, and classically said to aggravate pitta and rakta.

unani.note: Tamr hindi is barid in the Unani record and given specifically against bilious heat and thirst.
